script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.organization_id,
       j.command,
       j.job_status,
       j.lease_owner,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.row_version,
       j.attempt_count,
       j.idempotency_key,
       j.correlation_id,
       j.request_payload,
       j.is_deleted
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_GCguard.data.jobId}}

SELECT p.step_name, p.result_ref

 WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GCentry.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = CONCAT('GDC|', '{{node:code_node_GCentry.data.gdId}}') AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
